checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-version.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" version --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Show version information' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Display the version, build information, and runtime details' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" version >"$tmp/text"; grep -Fq 'ao version ' "$tmp/text"; grep -Fq 'Go version:' "$tmp/text"; grep -Fq 'Platform:' "$tmp/text"; "$tmp/ao" -o json version >"$tmp/json"; grep -Fq '"go_version"' "$tmp/json"; grep -Fq '"platform"' "$tmp/json"; "$tmp/ao" --version >"$tmp/root"; grep -Fq 'ao version ' "$tmp/root"; "$tmp/ao" -o json capabilities >"$tmp/caps"; grep -Fq 'ao.version' "$tmp/caps"

aliases.reason: The version family declares no command aliases.

rejected_args.reason: version accepts arbitrary positional args and rejects none.

stderr.reason: version writes only to stdout on success.

tracker_selection.reason: The version family does not select a repository issue tracker.

ordered_effects.reason: version is a pure read of build/runtime metadata with no ordered effects.
